# VANTA Agency — Digital Studio

> VANTA Agency is a full-stack digital studio specializing in high-performance web development, custom web applications, digital products, and brand experiences engineered for speed, conversion, and scalability.

## Core Services

- **Web Development**: Custom React & TypeScript web applications engineered for speed, security, and real-world performance.
- **UI/UX Design**: Modern, conversion-focused interface design and visual design systems.
- **API Engineering**: Robust RESTful APIs powered by Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL.
- **Performance Optimization**: Deep Core Web Vitals optimization, bundle splitting, and edge infrastructure alignment.

## Core Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: React 18, Vite 5, TypeScript 5, TailwindCSS / CSS Modules
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express 4, TypeScript 5, JWT Authentication
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15, Supabase
- **Storage**: Supabase Storage CDN (`vanta-media`)
- **Deployment**: Vercel Serverless Production (European Region `fra1`)
